description: This file defines a class JsonRpcErrorParser that extends AbstractErrorParser and implements error parsing for JSON-RPC responses within the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains methods for handling and normalizing error response data from AWS services.

classes.name: JsonRpcErrorParser
classes.description: A class that parses JSON-RPC error responses in AWS SDK for PHP, extending AbstractErrorParser.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the parser with optional Service and JsonParser objects.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an error response, extracts and normalizes error data from the response.
